description: This file defines interfaces (function prototypes) for creating ASN.1 related objects used in handling CRLs (Certificate Revocation Lists), including types such as CRL, TBSCertList, RevokedCertificate, RevokedCertificates, Signature, and CertificateList. It appears to be part of a code generation framework for ASN.1 objects related to X.509 certificate handling, with the functions primarily serving as object creators.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateCRL
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 CRL object, representing a Certificate Revocation List.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateTBSCertList
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 TBSCertList object, representing the 'to be signed' part of a CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateRevokedCertificate
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 RevokedCertificate object, representing a revoked certificate entry.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateRevokedCertificates
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 RevokedCertificates sequence, holding multiple RevokedCertificate entries.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateSignature
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 Signature object, representing the signature bits.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateCertificateList
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 CertificateList object, which is equivalent to a CRL.
